Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
One line to acknowledge the safe receipt of [£150 ](../others.html#160)on account with many thanks I don’t suppose you will receive this tomorrow but accept with it my best Christmas wishes

Yours truly

C M Yonge
